commits.subject: sdk: a built-in tool's scrubbed output goes back only in a shape the guard confirms (W15-12)
loop: a write and a cut-off retry are paid from the money below the run's line (W15-13, U-085, U-042)
budget-pause: "Left to do" counts only what the criteria still need (W15-14, U-042)
loop: one web search offer per run, fixed at its start, so the prompt cache holds (W15-15, U-042)
executor: the brief's search line follows what the run can pay (W15-17)
budget-pause: the wrap-up's words and amounts say what is true (W15-16, U-042, U-074)
estimates: a run the person stopped teaches the estimates nothing (W15-19, U-072)
result: the session says what you cancelled, what paused and why merges wait (W15-59, W15-69, W15-70, U-072, U-074)

fixed.problem: W15-12: on the subscription, Claude Code keeps a tool's ORIGINAL output when a PostToolUse hook's replacement fails the tool's output schema; the scrubbed output of a built-in tool was returned unchecked, so an unknown tool, a changed SDK shape or a key holding the secret could let a task's secret reach the model.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/security-sdk.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15 ... (W15-12)': each built-in tool fixture (WebFetch's url carried the value) and the five 'refused, never passed' cases
fixed.how: New packages/runtime/src/agent/cc-tool-outputs.ts: strict zod shapes for Bash, Read (6 variants), Edit, Write, Glob, Grep, NotebookEdit, TodoWrite, WebFetch, WebSearch, tied at compile time to the SDK's own output types; unconfirmedToolOutput() checks the original and the scrubbed replacement. sdk.ts's post hook fails closed: when redaction changed the output and the shape is not confirmed (or a key held the value), it writes a refuseToolOutput audit row, emits tool_denied, aborts the run with tool_not_allowed and returns continue:false (no replacement when a key held the secret). redactToolOutput now reports changed/keyHeld.
fixed.check_in_the_app: On the subscription, run a task whose secret appears in a built-in tool's output in a shape the guard does not know: the session log shows the tool denied and the run ends with '... so the run stopped before the model saw this task's secret.'; the audit shows the refused row; the model never receives the value.

fixed.problem: W15-13: a CHF 0.20 coder was told to wrap up after spending CHF 0.05 and wrote nothing (RUN-1); a research run paid for a whole-file reply that was cut and thrown away, and the retry asked up to 32,000 tokens with no room check (F8).
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/loop-cache.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15 ... (W15-13)' (RUN-1, kept writes and once-only retry, F8, note when nothing can be raised) and budget-pause.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15: a coder's multi-file write ...' (composed through the Messages API stand-in at Sonnet 5.5 prices: the write call got 4,096)
fixed.how: loop.ts sizes the write cap and the cut-off retry from the money below the run's wrap-up line only (line - spent - searches), bounds the first call by max(0.1 cap, the floor's price), raises only the retried call, keeps the complete tool_use blocks of a cut reply (the cut last call never runs) and tells the model what was kept (cutOffNote).
fixed.check_in_the_app: Give a coder task a CHF 0.20 budget that writes several files on the API key and start a session: it writes the files instead of hearing 'Wrap up now' after a few centimes; a reply cut at its limit keeps the files it wrote and the log names the cut once.

fixed.problem: W15-14: finished research that heard the wrap-up and wrote 'Left to do: - Nothing for the acceptance criteria. - Optionally, ...' was paused at its budget without review, and the person got a 'Continue (CHF 0.15 more)' card for done work.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/budget-pause.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15 ... (W15-14)' (live report, variants, request text, composed run) and apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15 > W15-14' (needs_human before)
fixed.how: budget-pause.ts NOTHING accepts a qualified 'nothing' (for the criteria/task/brief...), optional extras are parsed apart (RunHandoff.optional) and never count as unfinished work; the wrap-up text and WRAP_UP_BRIEF_LINE ask for 'Left to do:' only what the task's criteria still need, as a list, or nothing; no optional extras.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Run a researcher task at Budget 0.15 until it hears the wrap-up and lists 'Nothing for the acceptance criteria' plus an optional extra: the task goes to review and Done; no budget card appears in the Inbox.

fixed.problem: W15-15: a research run changed its web search offer (max_uses, or dropped the tool) call by call, rewriting the prompt cache: a quarter to a third of the run's cost was cache rewrites (F3).
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/loop-web-search.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15 ... (W15-15)' (8 different definitions in one run; 12 searches with 3 left)
fixed.how: The offer is decided once at the run's start (searchOfferAtStart in enforcement/budget.ts), with a fixed WEB_SEARCH_MAX_USES_PER_CALL = 2, and dropped once for good when it is no longer covered (searchOfferCovered); the stand-in prompt cache (testenv prompt-cache.ts) now keys on the web search tool so tests see the rewrite; anthropic.ts comment corrected and its non-null assertion removed.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Run a research task on the API key on the bench and read model-calls.jsonl: every call carries the same web search definition (max_uses 2) until it is dropped once, and cache_read_input_tokens keep growing.

fixed.problem: W15-17: a researcher at CHF 0.15 was told 'Use web_search to find pages' although no call of its run could pay for a search; it reported it had no web_search tool (F5).
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/executor-web-search.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15 ... (W15-17)' (the small budget's brief said WEB_SEARCH_LINE and the grant held web_search)
fixed.how: executor.ts searchPlanFor decides the offer before the brief with the loop's own helper and the run's cap, model and brief; it returns null when no search can be paid, so the brief and the grant say no search, and passes maxUses to the loop; WEB_SEARCH_LINE gained the clause on how many searches a call may make.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Start a researcher task with a CHF 0.15 budget: its brief (session Details) does not promise web_search; at a larger budget it does, with the per-call limit.

fixed.problem: W15-16: the session log said 'at CHF 0.07 it is told to wrap up' while the run was told at CHF 0.02; the model heard 'About a fifth of this task's budget is left' with 87% left; amounts under a centime read 'CHF 0.00'.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/budget-pause.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15: the wrap-up's words ... (W15-16)' (wrapUpText did not exist; limitWords said CHF 0.00; the start and told lines named a spend)
fixed.how: loop.ts wrapUpText(spent, cap) says the share used and that the next step could pass the reserve (WRAP_UP_MARK 'Wrap up now:'); budgetLineWords and wrapUpSentWords describe the real trigger (a step that could take it past CHF X, keeping a reserve of CHF R); executor chfText, limitWords and wrapUpSentWords go through moneyWords ('less than CHF 0.01').
fixed.check_in_the_app: Run a task with a small budget until it wraps up: the session log's start line reads 'before a step that could take it past CHF X it is told to wrap up, keeping a reserve of CHF R to finish', the told line names what it spent of its budget, and a pause under a centime says 'less than CHF 0.01'.

fixed.problem: W15-19: after Stop now, the plan card and the Start dialog gave different figures for the same task, and a restart moved the figure back (RUN-2).
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/estimates.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15: a stopped run teaches the estimates nothing (W15-19)' (observeTaskRuns returned true for the killed call)
fixed.how: estimates/model.ts NO_SAMPLE_CALL_OUTCOMES adds 'killed'; RunTally counts killed and completed runs and isNoSample leaves out a task whose stopped run no completed run followed, in the live feed and the fold alike; once a later run completes it, the stopped run's cost counts.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Approve and start a plan, press Stop now on the running task, then compare the plan card's figure with the Start dialog's for that task: they agree, and the same after restarting the app.

fixed.problem: W15-59, W15-69, W15-70: a session whose only task the person cancelled during review ended with 'CHF 0.01.' and nothing else (RUN-10); the end line counted a task paused at its budget as 'needs you'; one sentence mixed merges waiting for checks with GitHub not answering.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/writing-rules.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15: the result says what the person cancelled (W15-59)' and the split merge-later case (W15-70); event-lines.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15 ... (W15-69)'; continuity-cancel.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15 ... (W15-59)'
fixed.how: runner.ts puts the tasks the person cancelled in LastSessionOutcome.cancelled, session.ended carries a paused count and needsHuman leaves paused tasks out, and ResultFacts has checksPendingPrs and unansweredPrs (waitingPrs removed); session/result.ts writes the cancel sentence and two merge-later sentences; event-lines.ts endedCounts says 'N paused'.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Cancel the only task of a session while the critic reviews it: the session result says you cancelled it. Let a task pause at its budget: the end line says '1 paused', not '1 needs you'. With merges waiting, the result names checks pending and GitHub not answering in separate sentences.

fixed.problem: W15-20, W15-21: the Tasks row and drawer showed the work-only cost while Costs > By task counted the critic's reviews (RUN-3), and a running task read CHF 0.00 in the row and drawer until its run ended (RUN-4).
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15 > W15-20, W15-21' (timed out waiting for the first call's cost on the Tasks row: CHF 0.00) and apps/ui/test/tasks.test.tsx 'w15-run, wave 15: one figure per task (W15-20)'; later packages/runtime/test/executor.test.ts Run row failure case (found by the full run, test changed by design)
fixed.how: TaskView.spent is the cost ledger's figure for the task, reviews included (server reads costLedger.breakdown by task_id once per list); TasksTab's Cost cell and TaskDrawer show spent (actual from an older daemon). runner.ts books each model call's cost on the task in recordStep and adds only the rest at the end; executor.ts writes the Run row's cost after each call (awaited before the final total); task.addCost no longer bumps version, so a person's action during a run never meets version_conflict.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Start a session and open the project's Tasks tab while a task runs: its Cost rises after each call (bench AFTER: CHF 0.01 while running, BEFORE: CHF 0.00). After the run the row and the drawer show the same figure as Costs > By task (bench AFTER: CHF 0.09 both; BEFORE: CHF 0.05 on the row vs CHF 0.09 in Costs). Pause or Cancel during the run works.

fixed.problem: W15-22: credentialWaitNow let the first ready task decide for the whole project: a task for the person (no billing request) or a request that threw read as 'can run', so the Start check said nothing of the wait on the key's limit and a wake started a session before the reset.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-limits.test.ts 'w15-run, wave 15: a person's task does not decide the project's credential wait (W15-22)' (expected '' to contain '16:40')
fixed.how: compose.ts runNowProbe skips a task without a billing request, treats a failed request or pick as unknown, and says runs only when a task's pick succeeds; credentialWaitNow is its wait and the wake's predicate asks its runs.
fixed.check_in_the_app: With the API key at its limit, a project whose first ready task is yours and whose coder task waits: open Start session; it says nothing can run until the reset time, and no session starts before then.

notes_for_other_areas: loop.ts: WRAP_UP_TEXT is removed; use wrapUpText(spentUsdMicro, capUsdMicro) and WRAP_UP_MARK = 'Wrap up now:' (testenv/src/bench/role-player.ts WRAP_UP_MARK changed to match; scripts/bench/journeys/budget.cjs uses it). New model text cutOffNote(maxOut, where, kept) for a cut reply.

budget-pause.ts sentences changed: budgetLineWords '...: before a step that could take it past CHF X it is told to wrap up, keeping a reserve of CHF R to finish.'; wrapUpSentWords 'Told the S to wrap up: it spent A of B, and its next step could take it past CHF L.'; WRAP_UP_BRIEF_LINE asks for 'Left to do:' only what the task's criteria still need (no optional extras). RunHandoff gains `optional`; parseHandoff returns it. limitWords and wrapUpSentWords go through moneyWords ('less than CHF 0.01').

executor.ts: WEB_SEARCH_LINE gained a clause on the per-call limit; searchPlanFor(..., run) returns {limit, lists, maxUses} or null when no search can be paid; enforcement/budget.ts exports WEB_SEARCH_MAX_USES_PER_CALL = 2, searchOfferAtStart, searchOfferCovered; RunRequest.webSearch has maxUses. chfText goes through moneyWords. The Run row's cost is written after each model call (liveRunWrites), the end's write last.

Session outcome: LastSessionOutcome.cancelled (tasks the person cancelled); ResultFacts.checksPendingPrs and unansweredPrs replace waitingPrs; session.ended carries `paused` and needsHuman excludes paused tasks; event-lines endedCounts adds 'N paused'; session/result.ts has the cancel sentence and two merge-later sentences (NOT_NEWS includes the cancel sentence).

TaskView.spent (Money, optional): the ledger's figure for the task, reviews included (what Costs > By task shows); TaskView.actual stays the work-only budget counter. TasksTab Cost cell and TaskDrawer show spent ?? actual; the fake daemon's task views have spent.
task.addCost no longer bumps the task's version; the runner books each model call on the task in recordStep (bookedLive) and adds only the rest at the end.

Estimates: EstimateInput gains outcome and acceptance_criteria; taskSizeFactor() and SIZE_FACTOR_MAX exported; boundedPlanEstimate(guess, specialist, size = 1); EstimateTaskInput may carry outcome/acceptance_criteria; planEstimateUsdMicro passes the row's. NO_SAMPLE_CALL_OUTCOMES includes 'killed'; RunTally has killed and completed.

Critic session review: SessionMetrics.workUsdMicro and reviewsUsdMicro; with reviews the overrun finding reads 'Session work cost CHF W exceeded its estimate CHF E by N% (the reviews, CHF R more, are not in the estimate)' and the summary 'cost CHF T (work CHF W against an estimate of CHF E, reviews CHF R)'; without reviews the words are unchanged.
compose.ts: runNowProbe(projectId) -> {runs, wait}; credentialWaitNow is its wait and the wake predicate uses runs.

Security (W15-12): packages/runtime/src/agent/cc-tool-outputs.ts exports CC_TOOL_OUTPUT_SHAPES and unconfirmedToolOutput(); enforcement/hooks.ts redactToolOutput returns {value, changed, keyHeld} and refuseToolOutput() writes the audit row; a refused output stops the run with tool_not_allowed. A Claude Code SDK upgrade that changes a tool's output type fails the compile-time ties in cc-tool-outputs.ts.
